profiles.delivery_boundary: Version terms and vocabularies, retain multilingual labels and replacement lineage, and govern extensions.
profiles.acceptance: A deprecated term resolves to its replacement without rewriting historical applications.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Represent each application as a typed, source-scoped canonical decision rather than a bundled label field.
profiles.acceptance: Correction supersedes one application in scope and preserves the earlier decision.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Attach enforceable policy state to source identity, derived artifacts, exports, and external transfers.
profiles.acceptance: A restricted source blocks disallowed export or provider transfer and records the decision.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Separate region, raw reading, normalized reading, language assessment, graphic function, and correction lineage.
profiles.acceptance: Text correction preserves raw OCR and invalidates only dependents of the corrected region.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Persist calibrated, source-timed measurements separately from communicative-function interpretations.
profiles.acceptance: A measurement traces to frames and method calibration; its interpretation remains a candidate.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Keep true cuts, shots, transitions, scenes, and analyst scene revisions as distinct timed objects.
profiles.acceptance: A corrected shot boundary locally rebuilds membership and affected scene evidence without changing unrelated scenes.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Fingerprint the audio source and persist provider-versioned event intervals using governed terms.
profiles.acceptance: Changing the source fingerprint makes derived audio events stale while retaining their prior evidence.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Enforce provider hierarchy and bind measured intervals to the same source clock and fingerprints as transcript evidence.
profiles.acceptance: A higher-authority timing correction invalidates overlapping VAD-derived measures only.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Require active dependency proof, classifier provenance, representative outputs, and rights-aware lyric handling.
profiles.acceptance: Unavailable classifiers remain unavailable; lyric text cannot export against its rights state.
profiles.implementation_owner: optional audio classifiers and rights service

profiles.delivery_boundary: Use stable sample subjects, versioned models, cross-analysis isolation, and retained negative evidence.
profiles.acceptance: Similarity remains a candidate; rejection prevents repeat promotion without erasing the sample.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Model institutional stages as evidenced events with participants, roles, time, and decision state.
profiles.acceptance: A process stage cannot mature from an unscoped scene tag or keyword alone.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Keep implied, addressed, and actual audiences separate; distinguish expected response from observed reception and circulation evidence.
profiles.acceptance: Platform metadata cannot silently prove an actual audience or response.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Normalize producer lineage, source isolation, review state, and rejection memory for every candidate service.
profiles.acceptance: Candidate services cannot write canonical mature state or leak candidates across source scope.
profiles.implementation_owner: matcher governance and canonical write policy

profiles.delivery_boundary: Instrument every runtime stage with persisted developer-facing latency, resource, cache, and budget records.
profiles.acceptance: A representative run accounts for every declared execution stage without entering analyst truth projections.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Measure cost, yield, reuse, waste, and diminishing returns from real governed runs.
profiles.acceptance: Idle or active iteration can be compared by marginal mature yield without promoting operational metrics into evidence claims.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Persist duplicate-safe task identity, mappings, manifests, and correction lineage through export and re-import.
profiles.acceptance: Round-trip correction becomes a scoped canonical proposal or decision and duplicate task creation is prevented.

profiles.delivery_boundary: Govern optional capability detection, explicit activation, licensing, fallback, execution, and exported provenance.
profiles.acceptance: Disabled or unlicensed capability follows a tested fallback and never runs without an activation record.

summary.rule: Confirmed profile contracts enter the dependency graph as contracted or partial nodes; operational promotion requires implementation bindings, runtime evidence, and tests.
